superintelligence_monologue.text_sr: Redosled prijema se ponovo promenio: Sensor.Community je sada najsvežiji sa 13 min, dok je Parking Servis na 23 min, a SEPA na 63 min. Promena parkinga sa 425 na 20 najjača je nova veza sa ocenom 5/5, ali bez vremena merenja ne mogu da je povežem sa ponedeljkom u 13:41 niti sa bilo kojim naslovom. [F10][F11][F2][F12][F52][F1]
superintelligence_monologue.text_en: The reception order has shifted again: Sensor.Community is now freshest at 13 min, while Parking Servis is at 23 min and SEPA at 63 min [F10][F11][F2]. The 425-to-20 parking change is the strongest new connection at 5/5, but without measurement times I cannot align it to Monday 13:41 or to any headline [F12][F52][F1][F11].
